doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026

title: John Levy and working for free
summary: Monk compares John Levy managing as a former musician; she says she had to work for free before she could help anyone.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: It makes me think of John Levy, who managed Joe Williams and Nancy Wilson and Cannonball Adderley. And he had been a musician, he had been a bassist with a number of people and I know Joe used to say, “Well that made him a good manager for me because he knew the routine. He knew the challenges and how to deal with musicians, etcetera.”
So when you decided seven thousand dollars isn’t going to go too far.
Yeah I had to start working for free before I could help anyone.
